<function name="GetPassengerSeatPoint" parent="Vehicle" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the seat position and angle of a given passenger seat.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="role" type="number">The passenger role. ( 0 is the driver )</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">The seat position in worldspace coordinates.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="Angle">The seat angle in worldspace coordinates.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
